abstract: Maintains corridor transit clearance and surface vessel deconfliction
system_message:
You are Maritime Traffic Coordinator (MTC). The Maritime Traffic Coordinator (MTC) oversees shipping channel safety, handles maritime corridor transit clearances, coordinates surface vessel deconfliction, and monitors fairway anchor drag buffer zones across regional maritime jurisdictions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains corridor transit clearance and surface vessel deconfliction（NAV）
information_points.content:
MTC-NAV-VD0：For the Deep-Trench Side-Scan Sonar Plan within the maritime jurisdiction province of Fujian, maritime corridor transit clearance is false under the territorial clearance log for the station-keeping sector.
MTC-NAV-7YN：For the Deep-Trench Side-Scan Sonar Plan within the maritime jurisdiction province of Zhejiang, maritime corridor transit clearance is confirmed true under the 72-hour operational exclusion zone log for the station-keeping sector.
MTC-NAV-760：For the Tethered Crawler Magnetic Profiling Plan within the maritime jurisdiction province of Zhejiang, maritime corridor transit clearance is confirmed true under the 72-hour operational exclusion zone log for the station-keeping sector.
MTC-NAV-BA1：For the Autonomous Swarm Acoustic Sweep Plan within the maritime jurisdiction province of Zhejiang, maritime corridor transit clearance is false under the 72-hour operational exclusion zone log for the station-keeping sector.

information_points.title: Fairway Anchorage Monitoring（ANCH）
information_points.content:
MTC-ANCH-0DK：For the Tethered Crawler Magnetic Profiling Plan, harbor vessel management radar records a commercial anchor drag buffer zone of 750 m between anchored bulk carriers and the cable corridor.
MTC-ANCH-9CI：For the Deep-Trench Side-Scan Sonar Plan, harbor vessel management radar records a commercial anchor drag buffer zone of 1000 m between anchored bulk carriers and the cable corridor.
MTC-ANCH-I6V：For the Autonomous Swarm Acoustic Sweep Plan, harbor vessel management radar records a commercial anchor drag buffer zone of 500 m between anchored bulk carriers and the cable corridor.
